summary_en: Framework update on capital-cost and stock-price conscious management. Specific metrics and targets not disclosed in excerpt; full details in attached materials.
title_en: Response Regarding the Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Cost and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 10 July 2026, HI-LEX CORPORATION's board of directors approved an update to the company's capital-cost and stock-price conscious management framework. The announcement states that the company has re-analysed and reassessed its current position and has updated the content originally disclosed on 4 July 2025. The specific performance targets, financial metrics, and operational initiatives are contained in attached materials not provided in this excerpt. This is a framework refinement rather than a new programme announcement.
